components.name: SDUI5Modal
components.initSignature: Initialize(Callback As Object, Name As String, EventName As String)
components.description: SDUI5Modal is a **dual-mode** component: with `IsCard = False` (default) it renders a daisyUI `modal` dialog driven by a hidden checkbox toggle (`${name}_toggle`). Always open a dialog with `modal.Show` and close it with `modal.Close` so the checkbox state stays synchronized with the close and backdrop controls. Do **not** use the designer `Open` property or `setOpen` for dialog visibility: its setter only adds/removes the `modal-open` CSS class and does not synchronize the hidden checkbox, which can leave the close/backdrop behavior in the wrong state. With `IsCard = True` it renders a plain `card` (no toggle/backdrop) for inline panels. It auto-creates action buttons (Yes/No/Cancel/Ok/Retry/Abort/Ignore) based on `ActionType`, and hosts child content in sub-regions `${name}_form` (body/form), `${name}_action` (buttons), `${name}_box` (card body), `${name}_title`. It carries its own validation (`ResetValidation`/`Validate`/`IsValid`) over its `Form`; set `Html` for raw HTML body.
